name: A. Slide the north row 12' south
note: Barn B, the arena, cattle barn B and their turnouts all move 12' south. The gap between barn rows drops from 24' to 12'.

name: B. Swap barn B and the arena
note: Barn B takes the middle strip; the arena moves to the west run. The arena, not a barn, ends up on the wet corner.

name: C. Barn B beside barn A
note: Both small animal barns in the south row, side by side, each with a turnout. The north-west corner is left as pasture.

name: D. Barn B in the middle strip, south of the arena
note: Barn B goes where the feed containers are; the containers move to the west run's north slot. Barn B has no turnout of its own.

name: E. C, plus slide the arena and cattle barn B 12' south
note: Barn B beside barn A, and the two remaining north-row buildings pulled 12' south. Only a corner of the arena (5%) is left on wet soil.
